keyEvents.text: Goal! Vancouver Whitecaps FC 1, Seattle Sounders FC 0. Brian White (Vancouver Whitecaps FC) header from very close range to the top right corner. Assisted by Bruno Caicedo.

Goal! Vancouver Whitecaps FC 2, Seattle Sounders FC 0. Ryan Gauld (Vancouver Whitecaps FC) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Édier Ocampo.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
